description: This file defines the UserCreatedShelfService class, which manages user-created bookshelves in a book tracking application. It includes methods for creating, finding, saving, deleting, and retrieving shelves and their books, with checks for shelf name uniqueness and existence.

classes.name: UserCreatedShelfService
classes.description: Service class for managing user-created bookshelves, including creation, retrieval, deletion, and validation of shelf names within the application.

methods.name: createCustomShelf
methods.description: Creates a new UserCreatedShelf instance with the specified shelf name for the current user.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a UserCreatedShelf by its ID.

methods.name: findAllForLoggedInUser
methods.description: Retrieves all shelves for the current logged-in user.

methods.name: findByShelfNameAndLoggedInUser
methods.description: Finds a shelf by name for the current user.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a UserCreatedShelf, ensuring its name doesn't already exist.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of shelves.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all shelves matching the specified name; returns all if null.

methods.name: getBooksInCustomShelf
methods.description: Returns all books within the specified custom shelf name.

methods.name: getCustomShelfByName
methods.description: Retrieves a custom shelf by name wrapped in Optional.

methods.name: findOrCreate
methods.description: Finds an existing shelf or creates it if not found, for a given shelf name.
